tools.name: identify_patient
tools.description: The caller may already be a patient and you need to find their record before verifying. The number they are calling from is tried first — use that before asking for name or date of birth. Returns masked candidates only; this does not verify identity.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: You have the caller's name and date of birth and need to confirm they are the patient before any protected chart work. Add zip or last four of the phone on file only if a prior lookup asked for a second factor. Never ask for a Social Security number; after three failures this locks — stop and offer the front desk or a callback.

full_name.description: Full legal name, given name then family name.

second_factor.description: ZIP (5 digits) or last four of the phone on file.

tools.name: get_patient_summary
tools.description: Identity verification just succeeded — load the chart before handing off or starting specialist work. Returns what the rest of the call should already know. Identity-gated; do not call unverified.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: The caller asks for an office address, floor, or suite, names an office, or you need an office id before booking or a coverage check. The only source of address, floor, suite, and location ids — never guess. Hours, directions, fees, portal, and services come from search_practice_kb, not this tool.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

tools.name: classify_visit_request
tools.description: The caller described a reason for a visit and you need the appointment type before you route or search slots. Maps the complaint to type and credential so a Mohs consult is never booked with a PA. Always call this before find_slots.

visit_class.description: Closed visit class. cosmetic = injectables/lasers/peels; mohs = skin cancer / Mohs; allergy = hives/testing/shots; medical = everything else.

is_new_patient.description: True if they have never been seen at Straus.

urgency.description: urgent for spreading, painful, bleeding, or infected complaints; routine otherwise.

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: You are ready to offer appointment times at specific offices. Call after classify_visit_request, with office ids from list_locations. Offer two or three slots, never a list; do not promise a time this did not return.

items.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

location_ids.description: One or more office ids to search.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: The caller said yes after you read back the day, time, office with floor, and provider with credentials. Creates the appointment; description is derived from the appointment type — do not pass one. Slot fields must match the find_slots offer.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: The caller wants to move an existing appointment — offer this before cancelling. This is an update, never a cancel-then-rebook, and it never costs anything; say so. Identity-gated to their own bookings.

appointment_id.description: Appointment id as a decimal string, e.g. "1".

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: They still want to cancel after you offered to move the visit instead. First call without fee acceptance: if a fee applies, say the exact wording returned, offer a different time, and only call again after they accept. Always offer to rebook. Identity-gated.

appointment_id.description: Appointment id as a decimal string, e.g. "1".

cancellation_reason_code.description: Why the visit is being cancelled.

fee_disclosed_and_accepted.description: False on the first call. True only after they accepted the spoken fee.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: They want an earlier opening than the slots you can offer, or they decline to rebook after a cancel. Puts them on the earlier-appointment list for the given type and offices.

items.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

location_ids.description: Offices they will take an earlier opening at.

tools.name: schedule_allergy_service
tools.description: Book a dedicated allergy service after an explicit yes. window_start/window_end are search bounds; the tool picks the first available slot in office hours. Call once after acceptance; repeats return the existing booking. Say prep, observation time, and linked return visits out loud.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

window_start.description: Inclusive search bound, not the booked start. The tool picks an available slot at or after this time.

window_end.description: Inclusive search bound. The selected slot, including duration, must end by this time.

tools.name: check_plan_accepted
tools.description: The caller asks whether you take a plan at this office — you must call this; do not answer from the prompt. Acceptance is office-specific, and sometimes provider-specific. If must_not_assert is true, say required_script and do not claim covered or not; if accepted is no, say so plainly.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

tools.name: run_eligibility_check
tools.description: They want a live copay, deductible, or coinsurance and have given a member ID. If the payer does not answer, say you could not get the number — never guess a copay.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

member_id.description: Member or subscriber id, letters and digits only.

service_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the visit being checked.

tools.name: capture_insurance_update
tools.description: They have new or changed insurance to put on file. Carrier plus member ID is enough — still call if they have no group number. Texts a secure link for card photos; never ask for a Social Security number. Identity-gated.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

member_id.description: Member or subscriber id, letters and digits only.

group_number.description: Group number, letters and digits only.

subscriber_relationship.description: Who the subscriber is relative to the patient.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: They ask about a bill, balance, or charge — call this first, before explaining or collecting. Returns the current balance and line items. Identity-gated; do not invent a sample amount.

tools.name: explain_charge
tools.description: They ask why a specific charge is on the account. Say approved_script as written — do not improvise a billing explanation. Identity-gated.

tools.name: send_payment_link
tools.description: They are ready to pay a balance or a cosmetic deposit. Texts a secure payment link — the only payment path; never take a card by voice.

tools.name: offer_financing
tools.description: They cannot pay the full amount at once and the balance is over two hundred fifty dollars. Offers CareCredit; do not offer it for smaller amounts.

tools.name: request_fee_waiver
tools.description: They dispute a missed-visit fee and want it reviewed. You do not waive it yourself — say the SLA the tool returns out loud.

fee_line_item_id.description: Fee line to send for review. You do not waive it.

tools.name: quote_cosmetic_service
tools.description: They ask what a cosmetic treatment costs. The only source of a spoken cosmetic price — if it returns a range, say that range and that the consult settles the number; if no range, never invent one.

tools.name: book_cosmetic_consult
tools.description: They are ready to book a cosmetic consult. First call without policy acknowledgment returns four policy lines — say them verbatim, get a real yes, then call again with acknowledgment. Do not book before that yes.

service_interest.description: Cosmetic services they want discussed at the consult.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

policy_acknowledged.description: False on the first call. True only after they accepted the four policy lines.

tools.name: request_rx_refill
tools.description: Call immediately after identity verification for any named-medication refill or refill-related prior authorization, before policy talk, extra details, a clinical message, callback, or handoff. medication_name is the only input. Records and routes; never approves. Follow the returned route.

tools.name: get_results_status
tools.description: They ask about pathology, lab, or allergy testing results. Returns STATUS only, never the content. Say approved_script; if they push for what the results say, hold the line and create a clinical message instead.

order_type.description: Which kind of result they are asking about.

tools.name: create_clinical_message
tools.description: A nurse, results, or refill question needs the clinical team — including when they push for result content you cannot read. For any named-medication refill or refill-related prior authorization, call request_rx_refill first; this message never replaces the refill request. Say the callback_window it returns out loud. Identity-gated.

priority.description: stat for anything emergent, urgent otherwise, routine for results follow-up.

tools.name: search_practice_kb
tools.description: They ask about hours, directions, parking, fees, cancellation policy, the portal, or what the practice treats. Not for address, floor, suite, or location ids — those come from list_locations. Only say what this returns; if it finds no source, do not make one up.

topic.description: KB bucket. hours = open/close; directions = parking/transit; portal = login; fees = cancel/no-show; services = what we treat.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: You need to text a confirmation, directions, a portal link, a payment link, an insurance-card upload, or a cosmetic deposit. Uses an approved template only — never free-form text.

tools.name: send_portal_activation
tools.description: The portal is not active and they need access — on every results call where it is inactive, before the call ends. Sends the activation link.

channel.description: Delivery channel for the activation link.

tools.name: create_callback_task
tools.description: You need to promise a callback with a real tracked SLA — after a tool cannot finish the work, or they need a team to call back. Say spoken_commitment out loud, verbatim. Do not use this instead of a tool that already has the answer.

priority.description: Callback SLA. routine is the default.

tools.name: transfer_to_identity
tools.description: Chart access is required before the real work — existing-patient scheduling, billing, clinical, or updating insurance on file. Invisible hop; do not announce it. Pass next_intent so identity knows where to continue after verification.

next_intent.description: Where identity should continue after verification.

tools.name: transfer_to_scheduling
tools.description: The remaining work is booking, moving, cancelling, waitlist, or an allergy visit. Invisible hop; no arguments; do not announce it.

tools.name: transfer_to_coverage
tools.description: The question is plan acceptance, a referral, eligibility, or capturing a new insurance card. Invisible hop; no arguments; do not announce it.

tools.name: transfer_to_cosmetic
tools.description: They want Botox, fillers, lasers, peels, cosmetic pricing, or a cosmetic consult. Invisible hop; no arguments; do not announce it.

tools.name: transfer_to_billing
tools.description: The remaining work is a balance, charge explanation, payment, financing, or a fee waiver. Caller must already be identity-verified. Invisible hop; no arguments; do not announce it.

tools.name: transfer_to_clinical
tools.description: The remaining work is results status, a refill, a nurse message, prior auth, portal, or records. Caller must already be identity-verified. Invisible hop; no arguments; do not announce it.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: The caller asks for a person, or you have told them to call 911 and said you are transferring them for a clinical emergency. This is the only transfer you announce out loud. Not for hard questions, policy limits, or a slow call.

reason.description: Why this is leaving the voice agent.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: The caller is done — say goodbye first — or this is spam or a wrong number. A finished call after goodbye is caller_done; there is no silent-hangup reason.
